evals.name: previews before linking on a new machine
evals.prompt: I just got a new laptop with pi and Claude Code installed. Set up my agent configs on it.
evals.expected_output: Runs the install runbook in order: preflight, dry-run, link, post-link steps, credential check.
assertions: The response runs ./install.sh --dry-run and reads the output before linking anything.
The response verifies no credential file is staged before committing anything the install produced.

trigger_probes.prompt: New machine with pi and Claude Code installed. Get my agent setup onto it.
